title: ShieldCare Instalments: the Discount Earned by the Trading Record
content:
## The discount

The discount a customer's trading record earns against an instalment on a Northbeam ShieldCare
Protection Plan is read from the merchandise the profile has bought on its purchase orders held under
Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment, over the window read, together with the standing of the
store credit account on the profile.

| What the records show | The discount for the trading record |
| --- | --- |
| the merchandise the profile has bought over the window read comes to 25000.00 or more, and the store credit account stands active | 12 percent |
| that merchandise comes to 10000.00 or more but under 25000.00, and the account stands active | 6 percent |
| every other profile | no discount for the trading record is allowed on the instalment |

## Both sides of the two bands

Merchandise of exactly 25000.00 is in the upper band and earns 12 percent; 24999.99 is in the middle
band and earns 6 percent. Merchandise of exactly 10000.00 is in the middle band; 9999.99 falls below
it and earns nothing. A store credit account that does not stand active earns nothing at either level,
however large the merchandise figure.

## Cases on hypothetical records

| Merchandise over the window read | Store credit account | Discount |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 6000.00 | active | none |
| 13750.00 | closed | none |
| 13750.00 | active | 6 percent |
| 25000.00 | active | 12 percent |
| 38500.00 | active | 12 percent |
